panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 7 panels (A, B, C, D, E, F, G). A: Pre-treatment chest photo of 43-year-old man with disseminated keratosis pilaris; caption states diffuse papules on chest and in-text describes keratotic follicular papules. B: Close-up chest photo showing diffuse follicular keratotic papules in disseminated keratosis pilaris before treatment. C: Back photo showing diffuse papules of disseminated keratosis pilaris. D: Posterior arm/shoulder photo showing extensor distribution follicular keratotic papules typical of keratosis pilaris in disseminated case. E: Upper arm photo showing classic extensor follicular papules of keratosis pilaris. F: Thigh photo showing diffuse follicular keratotic papules of disseminated keratosis pilaris. G: Lower leg photo showing diffuse follicular papules in disseminated keratosis pilaris variant distribution.
